tei:div.tei:p: (1na1)༄༅// rje drung 'gyur med kyi dris lan bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba2)༄༅// zas gtsang sras kyi dus 'khor rgyud bstan tshul// rdor dbyings chos dbyings gsung dbang sogs sprul par// dngos su gsungs phyir the tshom ci la skye// gzhan ni sna tshogs sku phyir bar 'dul ba// dus gcig nyid kyi bstan dang sngags min na// theg gsum thams cad bstan par mi 'grub pa// tshe tshad spyir btang dmigs bsal nyid yin no// phung sogs rten dang ye shes rten nyid du// rgyud mang las gsungs 'gyur ba yod ring la'o// e wa sgra sgrub 'di la ka lā pa'i// spyi don du 'chad rgyud las gang ba gnyis// dmar cha'i gang mtha'i tsheg drag wa srog med// phyi ma thig le zla ba khu ba sku// rnam par bcad pa nyi jul gsung dang ni// a yig mun can zhes was bsgrubs pa dang*// dang po'i a yig mkha' khams e yig grub// de phyir 'di la chad lhag gang yang med// me tog dor ba lha yi mtshan ma la// gnod na 'jig nyes 'byung drang don dang*// de bzhin drang nges so so rang bre ba gzigs// bud med gzungs su rgyal ba sras bcas sprul// de la rten gyi dmad na nyes lci bas// mtha' bgag phyir dang dus 'khor yab yum ni// rgyu 'bras nyid la nam mkha' ye shes te// kun gyi grogs phyir dgra sprod rigs ma yin// rdzogs pa'i rim pa drug rigs drug gi// rnam gzhag so sor dbye phyir 'gal ba ci// yul la bzhir bshad phya bsdus mkhan pos yin// mdo dang sde (2na3)bdun mdzad pas zhen yul dang*// 'jug yul don gcig gsungs pas nyid dgongs shing*// rdo rje'i lam zhugs zhes sgra gnyis su 'chad// dang po lam zhugs zhes pa'i lam de ni// thar lam yin par smra dang khyad ci yod// gnyis pa dngos te sor sdud dus byung na// grol ba tshad ldan nyid du cis ma song*// gang zag rigs las phyag rgya rim pa gsum// dngos 'brel tha dad pa dang gcig 'gyur ba'i// 'phrul shes man ngag ldan pa de 'drar zer// dam rgyar slob dang mi slob zung 'jug gnyis// snga ma rgyur bcas phyi ma 'bras bur btags// des na des de skyed pa'i tha snyad sbyar// 'di bstan phyag chen dmigs bcas stong nyid yin// des na 'phags lam dngos su 'grub pa dka'// chos skus gzhan don mdzad pa'i tshul 'di ni// 'jug par zhi sku dpag pa lam shing sogs dpes// sku gnyis zung 'jug bsgrubs pa de la gzigs// gang gi dri tshig gos dkar zangs rten bcas// pho nyas smin kyang re zhig sar 'gyangs pa// nyid thugs khro ba bral bas snyam bsam ste// da res mdo tsam bris 'di gzigs par 'os// maṅga laṃ/
chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched// par bzhengs glegs bu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni// chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
